content:
Thrilled to share some exciting news! 🎉 I've been working with the CDS Hooks standard since 2017 and I'm incredibly honored to now be a member of the CDS Hooks Project Management Committee! I'm truly excited to help shape the future of this vital standard and contribute to its continued evolution.

For those of you already leveraging CDS Hooks to enhance your clinical decision support, I encourage you to add your implementation to the CDS Hooks Availability Wiki: [https://github.com/cds-hooks/docs/wiki/CDS-Hooks-Availability](https://github.com/cds-hooks/docs/wiki/CDS-Hooks-Availability) Your contributions help showcase the power and widespread adoption of this incredible tool!

And if you're exploring CDS Hooks and considering implementing it in your system, but aren't sure where to start, feel free to reach out. As a freelance consultant, I offer expertise in this area and can help you navigate the implementation process. Let's work together to drive data-driven healthcare forward! #CDSHooks #CDSHooksProject #ClinicalDecisionSupport #HealthcareIT #Standardization #FreelanceConsultant #Innovation #Excited
